question: En çok satan 10 kitap

answer.sql:
SELECT TOP 10 ITEMS.[NAME] AS kitap, SUM(CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8, 9) THEN INVOICE.[NETTOTAL] ELSE 0 END) AS satis
FROM [dbo].[LG_411_01_INVOICE] AS INVOICE
JOIN [dbo].[LG_411_WFTASK] AS WFTASK ON INVOICE.[WFLOWCRDREF] = WFTASK.[LOGICALREF]
JOIN [dbo].[LG_411_ITEMS] AS ITEMS ON WFTASK.[RECORDREF] = ITEMS.[LOGICALREF]
WHERE INVOICE.[CANCELLED] = 0
  AND INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (2, 3, 7, 8, 9)
  AND INVOICE.[DATE_] >= '2026-01-01' AND INVOICE.[DATE_] < '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY ITEMS.[NAME]
ORDER BY satis DESC

question: 2026 brüt kâr marjı

answer.sql:
SELECT 1 - SUM(CASE WHEN STLINE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8) AND STLINE.[OUTCOST] <> 0 THEN STLINE.[AMOUNT] * STLINE.[OUTCOST] ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN STLINE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8) AND STLINE.[OUTCOST] <> 0 THEN STLINE.[TOTAL] ELSE 0 END), 0) AS brut_kar_marj
FROM (SELECT [AMOUNT], [CANCELLED], [DATE_], [LINETYPE], [OUTCOST], [TOTAL], [TRCODE] FROM [dbo].[LG_211_01_STLINE] UNION ALL SELECT [AMOUNT], [CANCELLED], [DATE_], [LINETYPE], [OUTCOST], [TOTAL], [TRCODE] FROM [dbo].[LG_411_01_STLINE]) AS STLINE
WHERE STLINE.[CANCELLED] = 0
  AND STLINE.[CANCELLED] = 0
  AND STLINE.[LINETYPE] = 0
  AND STLINE.[TRCODE] IN (2, 3, 7, 8)
  AND STLINE.[DATE_] >= '2026-01-01' AND STLINE.[DATE_] < '2027-01-01'
